summary: Publish the Fabric adapter Nix package as fractal-fabric-adapter with a one-release legacy bridge

compatibility.detail: packages.fractal-fabric-adapter is primary; packages.st-fabric-adapter names the same derivation. bin/st-fabric-adapter is a relative symlink to fractal-fabric-adapter for one release. Both Cargo binary targets remain available.

downtime.detail: No service activation or state migration.

manual.detail: Existing Nix consumers continue to work; new consumers can select the new package and executable names.

recovery.detail: Identity and adapter journals are unchanged.
